name: product-inventory-catalog
title: Product Inventory Catalog
description: An e-commerce stock management table showing product SKUs, inventory counts, and reorder triggers.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Inventory Stock Management: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
